I have farmed barley in the Amhara highlands for many years, and on this small plot I will use chemical fertilizer because barley needs it to yield well here. I have kept my own local barley seed, so I do not need to spend money on improved seed from the market. My family can do most of the work, but I will hire a few days of help at weeding time.
